Zero console errors and zero page errors across every flow tested.

critical_code_review_comments: studyProgress.recordCardMark now correctly orders promotion BEFORE the toggle-off short-circuit: `if (requested === 'known' && (prev === 'known' || prev === 'mastered')) nextState = 'mastered'; else if (prev === requested) return cleared;`. This resolves the HIGH-severity spec deviation from iteration_13 without disturbing the anti-farming awarded-map behavior. The promotion path is guarded by `awarded['<cardId>:mastered']` so no XP is granted on promotion (consistent with the spec where mastery XP was never listed).

LearnCards.jsx button label logic `state === 'known' ? 'Master' : 'Known'` and progression to 'Mastered' after promotion is now visually consistent with the actual state machine. Users see 'Known' on new cards, 'Master' on known cards (invitation to promote), and 'Mastered' on the final state.
The share-*-card and share-*-copy testids are consistently named across Play/Test/Match via the ShareResultCard testid prop. Clean reuse pattern.

Reset uses `localStorage.removeItem('cloudforge_learning_progress')` which only touches the study progress key. Leaderboard entries live server-side (backend leaderboard collection) and are unaffected. Verified by direct innerText comparison of the leaderboard table before and after reset.
US English + no em dashes preserved across landing, learn hub, flashcards, play, test, match, and leaderboard pages (verified via em-dash count on landing body innerText = 0).

Mobile responsiveness: no overflow at 375px on any of the five audited pages. Track selector wraps cleanly, sticky Play submit tray fits, share result card breaks long URL string via break-all/leading-relaxed.

Audio/Voice toggle state is header-level; both persisted in localStorage (audio_enabled and voice_style keys) and rendered by AudioToggle.jsx and VoiceStyleToggle.jsx without console errors during cycle.
